topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: Because non-traditional index funds may be less correlated to the market, you may want to consider investing in them together with other types of funds. Depending on their characteristics, the other funds may help smooth out volatility and decrease risk.
question: Why might an investor consider holding a non-traditional index fund alongside other types of funds?
answer: A non-traditional index fund may behave differently from the market and traditional index funds because it may be less correlated to the market. Depending on the funds’ characteristics, holding other types of funds alongside it may help smooth out volatility and decrease risk, though this is not guaranteed.
